name: hypermnesia-mcp-codex
description: Cortex persistent local-first memory for Codex: the complete tool profile and the same eleven lifecycle hooks the Claude Code plugin installs.

interface.longDescription: Cortex gives Codex the same persistent memory Claude Code gets: the complete MCP tool profile plus the eleven lifecycle hooks that record sessions, inject context at session start and on every prompt, capture significant tool output, checkpoint before compaction, brief subagents, and gate edits against recorded decisions. Memory is local-first and shared with Claude Code through the same store.
defaultPrompt: Recall the decisions relevant to this repository.
Show what Cortex remembers about this project.
Store the durable lesson from this task.
